betaBanner.content: This is a new service. Help us improve it and give your feedback (opens in a new tab).

content.paragraph1: You completed your identity check online or at a Post Office using these details:
content.paragraph2: Some of these details might be used to automatically fill in the forms within the service you need to use.

updateUserDetailsInformation.detailsChangedParagraph1: Your proof of identity is still valid even if your details have changed.
updateUserDetailsInformation.detailsChangedParagraph2: You do not need to update your details to continue to the service you need to use.
updateUserDetailsInformation.detailsChangedParagraph3: When you continue, GOV.UK One Login will share your saved details with the service.
updateUserDetailsInformation.detailsChangedText: If you need to, you can
updateUserDetailsInformation.nameMistakeHeading: If there is a mistake in your name
updateUserDetailsInformation.nameMistakeParagraph1: Contact the GOV.UK One Login team (opens in new tab) if there is a mistake in your name. For example, if your name is missing letters or a hyphen.
updateUserDetailsInformation.nameMistakeParagraph2: Do not try to update your details or prove your identity again unless the GOV.UK One Login team has told you to.

progressButton.noJavascriptMessage: It can take up to 10 seconds to continue to the next page. After you continue, do not reload or close this page.
